definitions.explanation: Relating to the first or most fundamental level of something. Often used for beginner-level knowledge, skills, or mistakes.

examples.japanese: {初歩的|しょほてき}な{質問|しつもん}ですみません。
{初歩的|しょほてき}なミスをした。
これは{初歩的|しょほてき}な{文法|ぶんぽう}です。

notes:
USAGE: Used to describe something at a beginner or fundamental level. Often has a slightly apologetic or humble nuance when referring to one's own questions or mistakes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{初歩的|しょほてき}な{質問|しつもん} (basic question)
・{初歩的|しょほてき}なミス (elementary mistake)
・{初歩的|しょほてき}な{知識|ちしき} (basic knowledge)

RELATED WORDS:
・{初歩|しょほ} (the basics; first steps)
・{基本的|きほんてき} (fundamental - similar meaning)
